headline: Next harvests covered by the October 2026 issued ENSO outlook

index.target_policy: next typical harvest strictly after as_of; where that harvest ends after the issued coverage, the most recent completed harvest of the past year at the observed index (3 November 2026)
index.monthly_disaggregation: Minimum squared second differences, constrained to all issued seasonal means and observed months.
index.dependence: Common normal rank across seasonal distributions; assumed, not an issued joint ensemble.
index.unsupported: Withhold if any month of the crop window lacks observed or issued-path support.
index.interval_scope: response estimation and prescribed ENSO-input uncertainty; not full harvest yield

gate.usable_rule: skill_lo80 of the cluster aggregate skill > 0, else the country panel's skill_lo80 > 0

keys.panels: One medium ENSO-outlook row per country, crop and season. The fitted point contrast uses the ENSO-neutral baseline. lo/hi span the central 80% conditional ENSO-effect range; lo_resp/hi_resp vary response coefficients only. Full-harvest residual uncertainty is excluded. Detailed aggregate rows also carry the central 95% range.
keys.world: Production-weighted contrasts on covered reporting support. Ranges are computed after summing shared response fields; no addition of local interval endpoints.
